amazigh.alt: A shop sign in Morocco with the same text written three times: in Tifinagh letters, in Arabic, and in French.
amazigh.caption: A shop sign in Morocco: the same text in Tifinagh (the script used for Amazigh languages), Arabic and French.

fula.file: Chapeau berger Peul-Institut d'ethnologie de Strasbourg-2.jpg
fula.alt: A conical woven hat with leather trim and white diamond-shaped inlays, on a dark background.
fula.caption: A Fula herder's hat from the Fouta Djallon, Guinea (plant fibre and leather), in the ethnographic collection of the University of Strasbourg.

yoruba.file: Osun Osogbo Sacred Groove - The Sculpture of a Flying Tortoise.jpg
yoruba.alt: Large red-brown sculptures arching over a dirt path in a forest.
yoruba.caption: Sculptures along a path in the Osun-Osogbo Sacred Grove, a forest with shrines in Osun State, Nigeria.

maasai.alt: A round house of mud walls and a thatched roof, with a fence on the right and a bare hill behind.
maasai.caption: A house in a Maasai homestead (boma) in the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, Tanzania.

san.file: ELANDS - San rock paintings at Eland Cave, Cathedral Peak, South Africa, 2017.jpg
san.alt: A rock-shelter wall covered with red and ochre paintings of many antelope.
san.caption: A panel of San rock paintings at Eland Cave, Cathedral Peak area, Drakensberg, South Africa.

oromo.alt: Green mountain slopes with tall lobelia plants and trees under a cloudy sky.
oromo.caption: The Bale Mountains, in Ethiopia's Oromia region.
